0.0: Indeed, it is a my special Inference Vision! Look and see how I only need a few scant words to grasp the meaning. It has been honed over the thousands of hours of reading I do.
0.1: I don't know why I never considered using it for restoration purposes until now.
0.2: In any case, you say this document was left by an expedition team that sunk in the Deep Sea? And that they're missing to boot...
0.3: Please, citizen, allow me to give it a look.

0.msg: Hmm...yes. So they went to Deep Sea to find what caused an incident...

1.msg: As they descended, it became darker and darker... A wispy darkness seemed to take hold.

2.msg: Hmm? And in the depths there was...a crystal? And a castle was seen beyond it? But...

3.msg: Wait, is this real? You're sure this comes from an expedition team from the Deep Sea in Aqua Road?

4.msg: This is unbelievable. The one who wrote this journal witnessed a legend! Wait, this isn't the time for this. I need to preserve a copy of this document!

5.msg: Please wait there for a moment!

6.msg: #b(Wiz the Librarian hastily transcribed the note.)#k

7.msg: Ha! My Instant Transcription comes to the rescue again! Here, you can have the original back.

8.msg: I must say, you are a hero for having brought me such an important document!

9.msg: I mean, just read what is in this document.

10.msg: At the bottom of the depths, they found the Holychorus! A object thought to be mere legend!

11.msg: But it bore striking resemblance to the old stories: It sits at the bottom of Aquarium's Deep Sea and holds back a murky black fog.

12.msg: If this is true, it's the first ever sighting of the Holychorus. That's just how legendary it is!

13.msg: But if I'm understanding this right, the writer claims the Holychorus was blocking a...huge hole? It's hard to grasp exactly what they mean to say.

14.msg: Something like 'there are things you can't see in Maple World beyond the hole.'

15.msg: I think the truth may rest in those other artifacts you have. The camera especially.

16.msg: If that film hasn't been too damaged, it may be our greatest hope of learning what became of the expedition and the Holychorus.

17.msg: But who can we trust to...?

18.msg: Ah! Do you know of Han the Broker in Magatia? He can get you anything--for the right price.

19.msg: Maybe he'd be willing to offer a discount in exchange for information on the Holychorus...

20.msg: Anyway, thank you kindly for giving me the chance to read this. I'll make sure the copy kept here at Helios Library is well preserved.

21.msg: As thanks, let me send you straight over to Magatia. If you do find the missing expedition members, I would love to speak with them.

no.0: I may be good, but even I need the requisite materials to pull off a feat like this.

QuestInfo.name: [Aqua Road] It's All About What They Don't Say
QuestInfo.0: Taeng wants you to investigate the items his team left behind. You should see if Wiz the Librarian in Helios Tower Library can decipher the tattered note.
QuestInfo.1: Wiz the Librarian used a unique inferencing technique to restore the note. Surprisingly, the note is an eyewitness account of the #blegendary Holychorus#k said to be hidden in the Aquarium's Deep Sea. Wiz excitedly writes you a copy of the information. Now, you're off to see Han the Broker in Magatia to see if he can salvage anything from the broken camera.
QuestInfo.2: You met Han the Broker in Magatia to develop the film from the broken camera.
